sloka: अर्धस्य देवो वरदो वरार्धस्य तव ह्यहम् ।तस्मादर्धं गृहाण त्वं स्त्रीपुंसोर्यावदिच्छसि ।। ७.८७.२४ ॥
transliteration: ardhasya devo varado varārdhasya tava hyaham ।tasmādardhaṁ gṛhāṇa tvaṁ strīpuṁsoryāvadicchasi ।। 7.87.24 ॥

translations.english: The goddess declared that Shiva grants half of the boons, and she grants the other half, therefore the king should take as much of the male and female aspect as he desires.
